name: Soumya Sephali Sahoo

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Soumya Sephali Sahoo writes poetry in English and combines literary work with teaching. Rama Devi Women’s University’s English department report for 2019–20 records her supervision of undergraduate projects on subjects including women’s writing, Odisha’s folktales and myth. Engrace Foundation’s profile connects this academic background with her contributions to poetry and story anthologies, including ‘Unbottomed Purple Nous’ and ‘Resplendent Rainbow’.

Her two Kabita Live poems use familiar objects and performances to test larger wishes. In ‘Abracadabra’, a stage magician’s tricks become the starting point for imagining weapons turned into books and reconciliation in divided communities. ‘Paperboat’ works in the opposite direction: a long catalogue of Martha’s ambitions gives way to the fragile craft named in its title.
